purpose: Post-answer feedback routing for synthetic IT helpdesk scenarios; not a production accuracy claim.

labels.positive: User indicates the offered help worked or expresses thanks.
labels.neutral: User asks to continue, clarify, or provide more help without clear frustration or resolution.
labels.negative: User expresses frustration/abuse or explicitly asks for a human support handoff.

splitPolicy: Keep every paraphrase in the same splitGroup as its seed before any training or evaluation.
